title: Underwater Ocean Adventure
description: A young diver explores the wonders of the deep ocean

scenes.text: A young diver with scuba gear swims through a vibrant coral reef with tropical fish.
She discovers a sunken pirate ship covered in seaweed and treasure chests.
A wise old sea turtle guides her back to the surface through rays of sunlight.
